WITH monthly_demand AS ( SELECT p_type, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l_shipdate) AS mo, SUM(l_quantity) AS monthly_qty FROM part JOIN lineitem ON p_partkey = l_partkey GROUP BY p_type, mo ), avg_demand AS ( SELECT p_type, AVG(monthly_qty) AS avg_monthly FROM monthly_demand GROUP BY p_type ) SELECT md.p_type, md.mo, md.monthly_qty, ROUND(md.monthly_qty / NULLIF(ad.avg_monthly, 0), 4) AS seasonal_index FROM monthly_demand md JOIN avg_demand ad ON md.p_type = ad.p_type ORDER BY md.p_type, md.mo;

WITH hop1 AS ( SELECT l_orderkey, l_suppkey, l_partkey, l_receiptdate - l_shipdate AS transit_days, l_commitdate - o_orderdate AS promised_days, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS revenue FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey ), supplier_scores AS ( SELECT l_suppkey, AVG(transit_days) AS avg_transit, AVG(promised_days) AS avg_promised, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN transit_days >= promised_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) AS fulfillment_rate FROM hop1 GROUP BY l_suppkey ) SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, n_name, ROUND(avg_transit::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_transit_days, ROUND(avg_promised::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_promised_days, ROUND((100.0 * fulfillment_rate)::NUMERIC, 2) AS fulfillment_pct, ROUND(total_revenue::NUMERIC, 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND( ((fulfillment_rate * 50) + (50.0 / NULLIF(avg_transit, 0)))::NUMERIC, 4 ) AS efficiency_score FROM supplier_scores JOIN supplier ON l_suppkey = s_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey ORDER BY efficiency_score DESC LIMIT 40;
